mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and dampens equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term (PAYEMS change * UNRATE change) has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates a consumer spending slowdown that pressures corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the prior month, or the interaction term (HOUST change * RSAFS change) has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1100 thousand units signals a weakening residential construction sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates a broad-based consumer spending slowdown that pressures corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the prior month, or the interaction term (HOUST change * RSAFS change) has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
